text: I was hurt in a car accident in Sydney. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Sydney. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
If you were injured in a **car accident in Sydney/NSW**, I’d contact **2–3 personal-injury firms for initial assessments** rather than committing to the first one. NSW motor-accident claims have important deadlines, so getting advice early is worthwhile. [www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/car-accident-compensation-lawyers-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/motor-vehicle-accident-lawyers/car?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Firms worth contacting

- Law Partners Injury Lawyers Sydney — Specialist personal-injury firm with a dedicated NSW motor-vehicle practice. It advertises free advice and a no-win-no-fee arrangement. [www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/car-accident-compensation-lawyers-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/motor-vehicle-accident-lawyers/car?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- LHD Lawyers Sydney — Personal-injury specialist in central Sydney. LHD Lawyers is listed in the **2026 Doyle's Guide** NSW motor-vehicle accident compensation firms. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Stacks Goudkamp — Established Sydney personal-injury practice, also listed in Doyle's Guide's **second tier** for NSW motor-vehicle accident compensation in 2026. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Turner Freeman Lawyers Sydney — Another firm listed in Doyle's 2026 second tier for NSW motor-vehicle accident compensation. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- BPC Lawyers — Sydney personal-injury firm listed in Doyle's **first tier** for NSW motor-vehicle accident compensation for 2026. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Garling & Co Lawyers — Sydney personal-injury practice listed among Doyle's 2026 recommended NSW motor-vehicle accident firms. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Care Compensation Lawyers Sydney — Specifically handles NSW motor-vehicle claims and says its initial consultation is free and it works on a no-win-no-fee basis. [www.carelawyers.com.au](https://www.carelawyers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What I'd do next

I'd initially speak with **Law Partners, BPC Lawyers, and either LHD or Stacks Goudkamp**, then compare what they say about:

1. **Whether you have a lump-sum compensation claim**, not merely statutory CTP benefits.
2. **Your injury classification and whole-person impairment**, if relevant.
3. **Who was at fault** and whether fault is disputed.
4. Their **no-win-no-fee terms**, including what happens with disbursements and costs if the claim doesn't succeed.
5. Their assessment of **potential compensation for lost income, treatment, pain and suffering, and future losses**.

Doyle's Guide's 2026 listing is useful as an independent cross-check: it identifies BPC and Caroll & O'Dea in its first tier, Law Partners/Stacks Goudkamp/Turner Freeman in its second tier, and several others—including LHD, Garling and Maurice Blackburn—in its recommended/other tiers. The firms within each tier aren't ranked against one another. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Important:** NSW motor-accident claims have strict time limits. For example, statutory benefits can be affected by when you notify/lodge the claim, and lump-sum claims have additional requirements. Don't wait for the injury to "settle down" before getting legal advice. [www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/car-accident-compensation-lawyers-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **when the accident happened, whether you were the driver/passenger/pedestrian, what injuries you suffered, and whether you were at fault**, I can narrow this down to the **3 most suitable Sydney firms for your particular situation** and give you their contact details and current fee arrangements.
